description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans RuntimeTypeNameFormatter, which handles formatting and parsing of .NET type names for serialization and type resolution within the Orleans framework. It includes tests for recoverability, parsing accuracy, and error handling related to type name strings.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameFormatterTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the correctness and robustness of the Orleans RuntimeTypeNameFormatter and related type name parsing logic.

classes.name: Inner<T>
classes.description: A nested class used within the test cases to generate complex type scenarios for testing type name formatting and parsing.

methods.name: FormattedTypeNamesAreRecoverable
methods.description: Tests that formatted type names can be resolved back to the original types using Type.GetType.

methods.name: ParsedTypeNamesAreIdenticalToFormattedNames
methods.description: Ensures that parsing formatted type names results in names that, when reformatted, match the original formatted names.

methods.name: InvalidNamesThrowDescriptiveErrorMessage
methods.description: Verifies that invalid type name strings produce informative error messages with position indicators.
